info.description: Management API of the Minerva calendar sync agent: connected calendar accounts, synced calendars and events, sync history and event publishing.

id.description: The unique ID of the sync run

calendarId.description: The provider's ID of the calendar synced

source.description: The source label the calendar's events are stored under

type.description: Whether the run was full or incremental

finishedAt.description: An ISO-8601 formatted string indicating when the run ended

errorMessage.description: What went wrong, when the run failed

errorCount.description: The number of those runs that failed

avgDurationMs.description: The mean run duration in milliseconds

addedCount.description: The events added, summed over the day's runs

updatedCount.description: The events updated, summed over the day's runs

deletedCount.description: The events deleted, summed over the day's runs

syncRunStats.description: One entry per day and calendar with runs.
